name: head-agent-core
description: Provider-neutral HEAD continuity with a small constitutional core and optional review-gated Product, Graph, and execution governance.

interface.longDescription: A provider-neutral HEAD core with one Project, a common user-directed goal, and independently routed logical HEAD Sessions. Ordinary work uses bounded graph-first discovery with source fallback; review-gated Product governance, durable Runs, compaction recovery, bounded workers, and host coordination activate only when their protected outcome requires them.
capabilities: Independent Logical Sessions with Common User Direction
Bounded Graph-first Discovery with Source Fallback
Source-linked Selected Context with Omissions and Uncertainty
Quiet Success and Actionable Exception Presentation
Durable Runs with Fresh HEAD Review
Per-target Delivery State and Rollback Genealogy
Reuse-first Observation Preparation and Project-bound Host Source Collection
Rebuildable World Graph and Markdown Projections
Bounded Non-persisted Graph Lineage Trace and Diff
Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode Runtime Adapters
defaultPrompt: Initialize or resume the small provider-neutral HEAD Core and report readiness.
Inspect readiness and show the next safe action without activating optional governance.
